title: Settings, What's New, live chat
description: A rebuilt Settings, a What's New window for releases, and live chat in the app.

title: Grok, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5
description: New models to choose from, and cost tracking that accounts for caching.

title: Create with AI
description: Ask the agent to add its own integrations, skills and automations, and connect accounts before the first task.

title: Agent templates
description: Start from a ready-made agent in the marketplace, or save your own agent as a template.

title: Agents post to your channels
description: Connected agents can post, read and search Slack and Telegram from any run, and link back to their chat.

title: Agents on WhatsApp
description: Connect your WhatsApp Business number to an agent so it answers your customers there.

title: Agents in Slack
description: Connect an agent to Slack from Publish and mention it in any channel or thread.

title: Agents in Telegram
description: Scan a QR code to chat with your agent in Telegram, or connect your own bot.

title: A clearer chat
description: Follow a turn in one activity timeline, answer questions in one click, or just type to move on.

title: Docs on wide screens
description: The docs sidebar, page and outline now stay together on large monitors.

title: Edit files with your agent
description: Open and edit Markdown, text and code files in the Files pane while your agent works on the same files.

title: Connect ChatGPT
description: Sign in to ChatGPT from AI providers and choose the subscription when selecting an agent's model.

title: Test your automations
description: Create an automation, run a test, and follow every run in its own session.

title: A sidebar for busy workspaces
description: Group, filter, pin and reorder sessions, and start a new one from any agent.

title: Reuse skills across agents
description: Publish a skill once, install it in any agent, and apply updates when you choose.

title: Choose when agents ask
description: Set a default permission policy for an agent and review the tool-specific rules that can override it.

title: Custom secrets for agents
description: Store a credential as a project secret and attach it to an agent as a named environment variable instead of pasting it into chat.

title: Mention files with @
description: Search the session's files from the message box and insert the exact file reference into your instructions.

title: Edit queued instructions
description: Add follow-up instructions during a run and correct a queued message without losing its place or attachments.

title: Agent version history
description: Compare an earlier agent configuration with the current one and restore it as a new version without deleting history.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
description: Press ? to see every shortcut for sessions, panels, runs and approvals.

title: Agent icons and colors
description: Choose an icon and color for each agent so you can tell them apart in the sidebar and chat.

title: Dictate in agent chat
description: Speak your instructions into the message box, edit the transcript, and send when you are ready.

title: Agenta on Mobile
description: Chat with agents, follow live runs, and approve tool calls from your phone.

title: Slash Commands
description: Control the model and reference skills or tools without leaving the conversation.

title: Automation Runs
description: Review automated work, provide human input, and improve future runs.

title: API Keys Hidden from Sandboxes
description: Agents in a cloud sandbox now see a placeholder instead of your provider API keys.

title: Codex Harness
description: Run your agents on Codex, alongside Claude Code and Pi. Five OpenAI models, local or cloud sandbox.

title: Dark Mode
description: Agenta now has a dark theme. Switch between light, dark, and system from the top bar.

title: Annotation Queues
description: Annotate traces and test sets and turn them into evals.

title: Webhooks and GitHub Automations
description: Trigger webhooks or GitHub Actions when a prompt deployment happens in Agenta.

title: Tool Integrations in Playground
description: Connect Gmail, Slack, Notion, and 150+ tools to your prompts. Execute tool calls from the playground.

title: AI Prompt Refinement
description: Refine prompts with AI in the playground. Describe what to improve and get a refined version.

title: Enterprise Compliance Features
description: Multi-org support, SSO, domain verification, and a US region.
